card.title: My Past Self Is Watching
card.instruction: Behave as though an earlier version of yourself is judging every choice. Alternate between honoring that identity and deliberately betraying it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I promised my younger self I'd never leave this town.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You also wanted to live on the moon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Some ambitions were symbolic. Loyalty wasn't.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No. I'm taking the photograph so he can disapprove from a better view.
